commits.subject: Avoid rollout reads for configured TUI sessions (#39731)
evidence: N/A (equivalent): Go TUI session state comes from authoritative lifecycle responses; there is no rollout-read-based session inference for ThreadStarted to skip.

evidence: N/A (equivalent): Go execserver has no private fs/createDirectory flag or owner-private directory creation path.

commits.subject: Honor Guardian runtime settings from model defaults (#39738)
evidence: N/A (architecture): Go guardian review scoring is in-process and has no guardian-v2 extension crate boundary for model-default runtime settings.

commits.subject: Use model-specific auto-review outcome instructions (#39741)
evidence: Implemented: ModelMessages.AutoReview carries rejection_instructions/timeout_instructions (pointer fields preserve explicit empty overrides); the guardian reviewer uses the acting model's instructions for denied and timed-out reviews with legacy fallbacks (model/catalog.go, appserver/guardian_reviewer.go, agent_runtime.go). Tests added.

commits.subject: Skip postprocessing for short composer input (#39744)
evidence: N/A (equivalent): Go's grapheme-safe composer wrapper is a single pass with no separate word-boundary postprocessing pass to skip.

commits.subject: Refresh resumed thread capability roots from executors (#39746)
evidence: Implemented: combineSelectedCapabilityRoots refreshes matching thread-owned roots from live attachment roots (same root id + environment id) while preserving persisted roots when the executor reports none; used by EnvironmentManager.InspectSelectedCapabilityRoots and inspectSelectedCapabilityRootsForThread (appserver/environment.go, runtime_router.go). Tests added.

commits.subject: Require filesystem backends to implement directory walks (#39749)
evidence: N/A (equivalent): Go file-system backends already implement directory walks natively (fs/readDirectory local/remote); no shared trait boundary to enforce.

commits.subject: Expose uncompiled permission profile selection (#39752)
evidence: implementation_pending: add uncompiled permission profile selection (configured + managed catalog, managed default override, allowlist rejection).

commits.subject: Add managed developer instructions to requirements (#39755)
evidence: implementation_pending: parse managed developer instructions from requirements and propagate to thread start instructions.

commits.subject: Cache shell snapshots in the exec server (#39756)
evidence: N/A (equivalent): Go resolves shell environments per command without an executor-owned shell snapshot cache; behavior (correct env) is unchanged.

commits.subject: Standardize shell execution on unified exec (#39757)
evidence: N/A (architecture): Go routes all shell execution through its own unified exec implementation; no legacy shell runtime variants to retire.

commits.subject: Add app-server MCP event streaming (#39761)
evidence: Implemented: experimental mcpServer/event/stream/start|stop + mcpServer/event/stream/notification forwarding; connection-scoped subscriptions (64/connection), unique ids, 90s activation wait, 3-attempt reconnect with 1s/2s/4s backoff, auth-change/thread-unsubscribe/connection-close termination; continuous SSE streaming in the MCP HTTP client (mcp/events.go, mcp/http_client.go, appserver/mcp_event_stream.go). Tests added.

commits.subject: Include suggestion IDs in plugin install metadata (#39765)
evidence: Implemented: plugin install elicitation meta carries suggestion_id (same value as the elicitation request id); connectors omit it (tool/plugin_install.go). Tests added.

commits.subject: Refresh bundled model definitions (#39770)
evidence: Equivalent (automatic): Go reads models-manager/models.json from the Rust checkout, so the refreshed model definitions apply without a vendored copy.

commits.subject: Standardize shell execution on unified exec (#39772)
evidence: N/A (architecture): Go routes all shell execution through its own unified exec implementation; no legacy shell runtime variants to retire.

commits.subject: Verify Codex app signatures before launch or install (#39776)
evidence: N/A (platform): macOS-only app signature verification; Go doctor desktop checks run on the host platform and report N/A for non-macOS (Windows development host).

commits.subject: Retry transient registry failures during initial exec connection (#39777)
evidence: Implemented: initial Noise rendezvous connect retries transient registry failures (connect/timeout, interrupted bodies, 5xx/408/429/409 environment_offline) with 6s per-request timeout, 14s overall deadline, 4 retries, exponential jittered backoff; malformed complete JSON is terminal; one-time 401 bundle refresh keeps a fresh retry window (execserver/remote_harness.go, remote.go). Tests added.

commits.subject: Make tool-result telemetry limits configurable (#39779)
